questions.title: Even Odd Classifier
questions.description:
Read an integer and print "Even" if it is divisible by 2, otherwise "Odd". Use an if-else statement.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print "Even" or "Odd" on its own line.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= N <= 1000000

questions.title: Sign Classifier
questions.description:
Read an integer and print "Positive", "Negative", or "Zero" based on its sign using an if-else if-else ladder.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print "Positive" if N > 0, "Negative" if N < 0, else "Zero".

Constraints:
-1000000 <= N <= 1000000

questions.title: Larger of Two Integers Drill
questions.description:
Read two integers and print the larger of the two using an if-else statement.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print the maximum of A and B.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= A, B <= 1000000

questions.title: Vowel Consonant Checker
questions.description:
Read a single character and print "Vowel" if it is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u in either case), otherwise "Consonant". Use a switch-case statement.

Input Format:
A single character C.

Output Format:
Print "Vowel" or "Consonant" on its own line.

Constraints:
C is an English alphabetic character.
questions.inputconstrains: C is an English alphabetic character

questions.title: Pass Fail Threshold
questions.description:
Read a student's marks (out of 100) and print "Pass" if marks >= 40, otherwise "Fail".

Input Format:
A single integer MARKS.

Output Format:
Print "Pass" or "Fail".

Constraints:
0 <= MARKS <= 100

questions.title: Largest of Three Numbers
questions.description:
Read three integers and print the largest using nested if statements.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers A, B, C.

Output Format:
Print the maximum of the three values.

Constraints:
-1000000 <= A, B, C <= 1000000

questions.title: ATM Withdrawal Approval
questions.description:
An ATM checks whether a customer's requested withdrawal amount does not exceed the available balance. Read the balance and the requested amount and print "Approved" or "Declined".

Input Format:
Two space-separated floating-point values: BALANCE and AMOUNT.

Output Format:
Print "Approved" if AMOUNT <= BALANCE, otherwise "Declined".

Constraints:
0.0 <= BALANCE <= 1000000.0, 0.0 <= AMOUNT <= 1000000.0

questions.title: Voting Eligibility Check
questions.description:
An election officer reads a citizen's age and decides whether they are eligible to vote. Eligibility requires age >= 18.

Input Format:
A single integer AGE.

Output Format:
Print "Eligible" or "Not Eligible".

Constraints:
0 <= AGE <= 150

questions.title: Day Name from Number
questions.description:
A scheduling app reads a day number (1-7) and prints the corresponding weekday name using a switch-case statement.

Input Format:
A single integer DAY in [1, 7].

Output Format:
Print "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", or "Sunday" for inputs 1 through 7. Print "Invalid" for any other input.

Constraints:
DAY is an integer.

questions.title: Season from Month
questions.description:
A weather service reads a month number (1-12) and identifies the meteorological season using an else-if ladder:
Mar-May: Spring, Jun-Aug: Summer, Sep-Nov: Autumn, Dec, Jan, Feb: Winter.

Input Format:
A single integer MONTH.

Output Format:
Print "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", or "Invalid" if out of range.

Constraints:
MONTH is an integer.

questions.title: Switch-Based Calculator
questions.description:
A pocket calculator reads an operator character and two operands, then performs the corresponding arithmetic operation using a switch-case statement. For division by zero, output 0.00.

Input Format:
Three space-separated tokens: OP (one of +, -, *, /), then two floating-point operands A and B.

Output Format:
Print the result of A OP B to two decimals.

Constraints:
-1000000.0 <= A, B <= 1000000.0

questions.title: Cartesian Quadrant Finder
questions.description:
A geometry tool reads the (x, y) coordinates of a point and identifies which quadrant it lies in using an if-else if ladder.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers X and Y.

Output Format:
Print "Quadrant 1", "Quadrant 2", "Quadrant 3", "Quadrant 4", "Axis", or "Origin".

Constraints:
-10000 <= X, Y <= 10000

questions.title: Triangle Type Classifier
questions.description:
A geometry drill reads three side lengths and classifies the triangle as Equilateral, Isosceles, or Scalene. If the sides cannot form a valid triangle, print "Not Triangle" instead. Use nested if statements inside an outer validity check.

Input Format:
Three space-separated integers A, B, C representing the side lengths.

Output Format:
Print "Equilateral", "Isosceles", "Scalene", or "Not Triangle".

Constraints:
1 <= A, B, C <= 10000

questions.title: Month Days Printer
questions.description:
A calendar utility reads a month number (1-12) and prints how many days that month has in a non-leap year. Use a switch statement that groups cases by fall-through.

Input Format:
A single integer MONTH in [1, 12].

Output Format:
Print the number of days (28, 30, or 31) for the month, or 0 if the month is out of range.

Constraints:
MONTH is an integer.

questions.title: Speeding Fine Tier Calculator
questions.description:
A traffic police system reads a vehicle's speed (in km/h) and computes the fine using a tiered else-if ladder:
- speed <= 60: fine 0
- 61 to 80: fine 500
- 81 to 100: fine 1000
- above 100: fine 2000

Input Format:
A single integer SPEED.

Output Format:
Print the fine amount as an integer.

Constraints:
0 <= SPEED <= 300

questions.title: Traffic Light Action Decoder
questions.description:
A traffic light controller reads a single letter (R, Y, G, case-insensitive) and prints the action a driver must take. Use a switch statement with a default case for invalid input.

Input Format:
A single character C.

Output Format:
Print "Stop" for R/r, "Slow" for Y/y, "Go" for G/g, or "Invalid" for any other character.

Constraints:
C is a printable ASCII character.
questions.inputconstrains: C is a printable ASCII character

questions.title: BMI Health Category Reporter
questions.description:
A health clinic records the weight (kg) and height (m) of N patients and computes each patient's BMI = weight / (height * height). It then classifies them:
- BMI < 18.5: Underweight
- 18.5 to 24.9: Normal
- 25 to 29.9: Overweight
- 30 or above: Obese

After processing all patients, print the four category counts.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N.
Next N lines: two space-separated floating-point values WEIGHT and HEIGHT.

Output Format:
Print four lines:
"Underweight: <count>"
"Normal: <count>"
"Overweight: <count>"
"Obese: <count>"

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1.0 <= WEIGHT <= 500.0, 0.5 <= HEIGHT <= 3.0

questions.title: Banking Transaction Processor
questions.description:
A bank processes N transactions against an account starting with a balance of 0.0. Each transaction has a type letter and an amount:
- 'D' (deposit): add the amount to the balance.
- 'W' (withdraw): subtract the amount only if it does not exceed the balance; otherwise ignore.
- 'B' (balance check): no change to the balance.

Use a switch on the type, with a nested if for the withdrawal case. Print the final balance.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N.
Next N lines: a character TYPE and a floating-point AMOUNT, space-separated.

Output Format:
Print the final balance to two decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0.0 <= AMOUNT <= 1000000.0

questions.title: Book Loan Status Decoder
questions.description:
A library reads N book records. Each record contains a status code (1 = Available, 2 = Borrowed, 3 = Reserved, 4 = Lost) and a member type (0 = Guest, 1 = Member). Based on the status and member type, print one action per book:
- Available: "Available"
- Borrowed: "Return" if Member, "Denied" if Guest
- Reserved: "Pickup" if Member, "Denied" if Guest
- Lost: "Report"
- any other status: "Invalid"

Use a switch on the status with nested if statements for member-only cases.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N.
Next N lines: two space-separated integers STATUS and MEMBER.

Output Format:
Print one action per line, in input order.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, STATUS is an integer, MEMBER is 0 or 1
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= N <= 1000, STATUS is an integer, MEMBER is 0 or 1

questions.title: Shipping Cost Tier Calculator
questions.description:
A courier service computes the cost of shipping N packages. For each package the cost is the sum of a weight tier and a distance tier:
Weight tiers (kg):
- weight <= 1.0: 10.00
- weight <= 5.0: 20.00
- weight <= 10.0: 50.00
- otherwise: 100.00
Distance tiers (km):
- distance <= 100.0: 5.00
- distance <= 500.0: 15.00
- otherwise: 30.00

Print the total cost across all packages.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N.
Next N lines: two space-separated floating-point values WEIGHT and DISTANCE.

Output Format:
Print the total cost to two decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 0.0 <= WEIGHT <= 1000.0, 0.0 <= DISTANCE <= 100000.0
